joinedLine: My name opens the crew account. Your choice is money or a missing car or a useful part.
grudgeLine: I am still backing you. Keep your bumper off my crew.

joinedLine: The crew stands with you. Every stolen credit will return even after the debt is paid.
grudgeLine: We share a cause. That does not make my steel yours to break.

joinedLine: The north road stays open. My couriers carry your name and the unedited recording.
grudgeLine: You took my line. Earn the next one clean.

joinedLine: Every crew holds a copy. My endorsement opens the Crown gates for all of us.
grudgeLine: I kept the evidence safe. Keep my driver safe too.
